transcript: So for the third quarter I think we have to decide whether the search improvements or the mobile app ship first. The mobile app has more customer requests, but search is a smaller piece of work. If we pick search first we could release it by August and still start the mobile work in September. What does engineering say about the timeline?

Morning everyone, can you all hear me okay? Great. Give me one more minute, I think a few more people are still joining. Oh, hi, welcome. Alright, I think we have everybody, so let's get started with the first topic on the agenda, the product roadmap for this quarter.

Ha, yes, my cat just walked across the keyboard again, sorry about that. Anyway, back to the roadmap. I was saying the priority list needs one owner per feature, otherwise nothing gets scheduled. Can we agree that the search feature gets Maria's old slot in the sprint plan, and that the mobile app work starts after the August release?

Okay, I think the roadmap is settled. Let's talk about hiring now. We have two senior backend engineer roles open and the recruiter says the pipeline is thin. We need to decide whether to change the interview process, maybe cut one round, and whether we can approve a third position for the data team before the end of the quarter.

Right, that covers the open roles. Next is the budget. The cloud bill went up about twenty percent last month, mostly because of the new staging environment, and marketing wants to double its ad spend next quarter. We have to figure out what we can actually afford and where we can cut infrastructure costs.

Did you see the game last night? I cannot believe that last-minute penalty. The referee completely ruined it for them. My brother in law was at the stadium and he said the whole crowd was furious. And the goalkeeper, honestly, he should have been the player of the match, those saves in the second half were unreal. They have to win the next two matches to stay in the league.

We booked a small hotel on the island in Greece for the second week of July. It is right next to the beach, with breakfast included. We are thinking about renting a scooter to get around, but my wife is not sure about that. Do you know if the ferries run every day, or only on weekends? Last time we went, the weather was perfect the whole time.

Should we just order pizza or is everyone tired of pizza? There is that new sushi place near the station, but it is expensive and the delivery takes forever. I could go for a burger honestly. Or we could do the Thai place from two weeks ago, the one with the green curry. Who is vegetarian again? We need to order soon or the lunch break is going to be over.

I finally finished that crime series everyone was talking about. The last episode was a bit slow, but the ending was great, I did not see the twist coming at all. Now I need something new to watch over the weekend. Do you have any recommendations? I like detective stories, but not too dark. Maybe something with a bit of humor in it.

We are planning a hiking trip in the mountains for the weekend if the weather holds. The only problem is my car, the garage says the brakes need to be replaced and it will cost more than I expected. I might borrow my neighbour's van instead. Do you think the trail is open already, or is there still snow on the upper part?

For the backend roles I would keep the take-home assignment, but shorten it to two hours. Candidates drop out when it takes a whole weekend. The second interview could be a pairing session with someone from the team. And we should ask the recruiter to widen the search to people who work remotely in nearby time zones.

If we shut down the staging environment at night and on weekends we could save about a third of that cloud cost. For marketing, I would not double the spend at once. Let's raise it by half and look at the results after a month before we commit the rest of the money.
